metric_definitions.mae: Mean Absolute Error; lower is better.
metric_definitions.rmse: Root Mean Squared Error; lower is better.
metric_definitions.mape_pct: Mean Absolute Percentage Error; zero actuals excluded.
metric_definitions.wmape_pct: Weighted Mean Absolute Percentage Error; lower is better.
metric_definitions.forecast_bias: Mean predicted minus actual; positive means overprediction.
metric_definitions.forecast_bias_pct: Total prediction error divided by total actuals, as percent.
